ai.summary: China proposed restricting or banning exports of 40 technologies, including 23 AI-related technologies such as large models and AI agents, citing national security. The proposal would add a new front to the technology competition with the United States.
ai.title: China moves to curb tech exports, including AI, citing national security risks

ai.summary: Eight U.S. states sued OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT caused harm to users, including young people, and that the company misled the public about safeguards. The states are seeking legal remedies and changes to the chatbot’s safety practices; the allegations have not been adjudicated.
ai.title: Eight US states sue OpenAI, claiming ChatGPT harms young users

ai.summary: DeepSeek reportedly updated its V4.1 Flash model, replacing the version available through its web service, app and developer API. The report identifies improvements as a focus of the release, but does not provide independent verification of performance claims.
ai.title: 7 AI News Highlights of the Day | October 18, 2026

ai.summary: MIT researchers reported a materials-design system that combines text with visual information about atomic structures and bonding. In a paper in *Nature Communications*, they found it could identify better material designs than models trained on text alone.
ai.title: Giving AI a “crystal clear” view of the materials world

ai.summary: China’s draft plan would prohibit exports of 14 technologies and require approval for 26 others, with AI accounting for 23 of the listed technologies. The proposed controls cover areas including large models and AI agents; the measures are not yet final.
ai.title: China to limit exports of 40 key technologies, including AI and solar

quantum.summary: Google Quantum AI demonstrated magic-state cultivation on its Willow processor, reporting a 40-fold reduction in errors and 99.99% fidelity for retained T states. The experiment also transferred states between color-code and surface-code error-correction schemes; scaling the approach remains a challenge.
quantum.title: Google cuts quantum processor errors 40-fold with magic-state cultivation

quantum.summary: RIKEN researchers and collaborators demonstrated simultaneous control of five silicon spin qubits using a shared microwave line and calibration to offset interference. Reported gate fidelity was about 99.9% across five qubits and above 99.99% when operating up to three, a result relevant to scaling silicon hardware.
quantum.title: RIKEN achieves near-99.9% control accuracy for silicon qubits

quantum.summary: Quantum X Labs said its LayerQake calibration method was tested on three IBM processors and reduced maximum cumulative error by a factor of 15 to 21. The company also reported measurement bias below 6%; these are company-reported results and independent validation was not established in the available report.
quantum.title: Quantum X Labs reports reduced errors on IBM quantum hardware

quantum.summary: A report on a U.S. Government Accountability Office audit says none of 24 major federal agencies had fully prepared digital-identity systems for quantum-related threats ahead of an October 22 planning deadline. The finding concerns post-quantum security readiness rather than a new quantum-computing capability.
quantum.title: US GAO warns agencies lack quantum defenses for digital identity
